limitations: All cohorts are SYNTHETIC, made by lib/synth/als, and the checks were designed against that same generator family. The flaws are injected by this script at graded strengths, one at a time. These numbers describe how the checks behave on that setup. They do not measure performance on real data, real vendors, or flaws that look different from the ones planted here. A pass is a screen, not proof.

tuning: The imbalance check was changed after a first run of this eval (commit 078aab0) showed it flagged most small clean cohorts: the standardized difference must now also exceed 2.58 standard errors (SMD_NOISE_Z). That rule was tuned on base seed 1000, the seeds of the main tables, so the main imbalance numbers are in-sample. The freshSeeds block re-runs clean and imbalance on base seed 900000, which was not used for tuning. Every other threshold is unchanged from before the eval.
